Victorian local government area boundaries

Source: R/data_vic_lga.R
vic_lga.Rd

Simplified boundaries of the local government areas (LGAs) in Victoria, for mapping.

Usage

vic_lga

Format

An sf object (a tibble with a geometry column) with 80 rows and 4 columns:

lga_code

(character) ABS LGA code.

lga_name

(character) LGA name in capitals, for example MERRI-BEK.

unincorporated

(logical) TRUE for the unincorporated areas (alpine resorts and islands).

geometry

(sfc_MULTIPOLYGON) Boundary, in longitude and latitude (WGS 84).

Source

Department of Transport and Planning, State of Victoria, Vicmap Admin - Local Government Area (LGA) Polygon Aligned to Property (resource LGA_POLYGON, metadata ID cff349f9-3ef3-51bd-b5a9-ae650f6d6c24), published 16 October 2026, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Retrieved 25 October 2026. https://discover.data.vic.gov.au/dataset/vicmap-admin-local-government-area-lga-polygon-aligned-to-property.

Changes made: kept the ABS code and name; merged the unincorporated areas into one UNINCORPORATED VIC feature; added unincorporated; converted to WGS 84; simplified with a 100 m tolerance; sorted by name.
